source: Official BLS archived CPI news releases

structural_withheld.2025-10: BLS did not publish an October 2025 CPI news release because of the 2025 lapse in federal government appropriations.

source_exceptions.2016-05: Official BLS June 16 2016 HTML rendering is not parser-complete; reference month, 08:30 EDT timestamp, headline 1.0% YoY and core 2.2% YoY are certified from the official BLS archived PDF/release schedule.

method: Opening archived CPI release text only; no current/revised-history substitution. One isolated 2016 source-rendering exception is explicitly certified from the contemporaneous official archived PDF.
notes: This is a CPI release-state block, not a claim that CPI is the Fed preferred inflation gauge; PCE remains conceptually distinct.
